# Cocoon runtime

Unmodified `framework.src.js`, `framework.min.js`, and license from the public
`Nashorn/od-cocoon` 8.6.0 branch, retrieved September 23, 2026.

The landing page currently loads the source distribution. The minified artifact
is retained alongside it for the documented release-size measurement.
Keep the license with either distribution. Do not patch these vendor files to
change the demonstration; the application lives in `public/showcase/`.
